input.rationale: This citation describes an unpublished internal note from the Aurora Institute, which by definition would not be registered in Crossref, OpenAlex, or similar scholarly indexes. None of the candidates returned by the search match this work - they are unrelated published papers/preprints from different authors (Kovacev/Hussein, Askitas, Institute for Monetary and Financial Research, Candiotto, Grewal et al.) on different topics. 'Aurora' only coincidentally appears in one candidate's journal title (Revista de Filosofia Aurora), not as the organizational author. Since unpublished internal notes are typically not assigned DOIs or indexed in these databases, no genuine match exists.
